name: Crispy Rice Omelette with Gochujang Butter
desc: Leftover rice fried crisp in gochujang butter, set with eggs and folded like an omelette.

source.title: Crispy Rice Omelette (gochujang butter)
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1/4 cup mixed corn kernels, sliced green onion greens and cilantro leaves
ingredients.item: mixed corn kernels, sliced green onion greens and cilantro leaves

steps: Break up the rice with your hands to remove any clumps. Mash the gochujang and butter together.
Heat the oil in a 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the rice 1 minute, then add the gochujang butter and toss to coat.
Press the rice into a flat, even circle across the bottom of the pan and leave it to fry 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour the eggs over the rice, cover and cook about 1 minute, until the egg is starting to set.
Uncover, scatter the corn, green onion and cilantro on top and fry 1 minute more, until the rice underneath is crisp and pulling away from the pan.
Loosen the edges and bottom with a spatula and fold the omelette in half in one motion. Slide onto a plate.
tips: Day-old refrigerated rice crisps best; fresh warm rice turns gummy.
